text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Environment Setup

on:
  workflow_dispatch

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Copy activation job files to agent environment
        uses: githubnext/gh-aw/actions/setup@v0.36.0
        with:
          destination: /home/runner/.copilot/agent

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build project
        run: pnpm run build
```
